description: Source code implementing a custom printf-like function with support for various data types, floating point formatting, and custom conversion specifications within the Zephyr RTOS environment.

methods.name: extract_decimal
methods.description: Parses a sequence of decimal digits from a string, updating the string pointer.

methods.name: extract_flags
methods.description: Extracts printf-style flags from a format specifier string.

methods.name: extract_width
methods.description: Extracts width specification from a format specifier string.

methods.name: extract_prec
methods.description: Extracts precision specification from a format specifier string.

methods.name: extract_length
methods.description: Extracts length modifier from a format specifier string.

methods.name: extract_specifier
methods.description: Extracts the conversion specifier character and updates the conversion structure.

methods.name: extract_conversion
methods.description: Parses a complete printf conversion specification from a format string.

methods.name: _ldiv5
methods.description: Performs division of a 64-bit integer by 5, optimized for 64-bit and 32-bit architectures.

methods.name: _ldiv10
methods.description: Performs division of a 64-bit integer by 10.

methods.name: _get_digit
methods.description: Extracts the next decimal digit from a fractional component.

methods.name: conversion_radix
methods.description: Returns the numeric base for a given format specifier.

methods.name: encode_uint
methods.description: Encodes an unsigned integer into a buffer in a specified base, handling formatting flags.

methods.name: encode_float
methods.description: Converts a double-precision floating point value into a string representation with specified precision and formatting.

methods.name: store_count
methods.description: Stores a count value into a pointer, respecting the length modifier.

methods.name: outs
methods.description: Outputs a sequence of characters via a callback, handling errors.

methods.name: z_cbvprintf_impl
methods.description: Main implementation of a printf-like function supporting various format specifiers, floating point, and custom formatting within Zephyr.
